Payout of 9 July is short ₹1,553.00.
The bank credited ₹1,30,409.70 against an expected ₹1,31,962.70. 23 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000004 of ₹1,553.00, issued 24 July against payment pay_000073. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000004 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000004 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
